en:
## New Features

- Unified background task management: bash and agent background tasks are now persisted to database, surviving server restarts
- New `AwaitBackgroundTask` tool for waiting on background tasks with text-matching and timeout support
- Built-in gateway global HTTPS proxy support with dedicated settings page
- Subagent tabs now appear as a distinct tab type with robot icon and back-navigation to parent narrator
- SWE-bench evaluator now runs in isolated Podman containers with automatic repo setup
- ExitPlanMode permission now shows a confirmation dialog when feedback text is present

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed Anthropic API 400 errors caused by thinking blocks from third-party compatible APIs (e.g. DeepSeek)
- Fixed multiple frontend memory leaks: screenshot blob URLs, avatar fetch races, PixiJS destroy crashes, click blocker timers, terminal disposables
- Fixed `start:dev` WebSocket port injection failure when running Vite in production mode
- Fixed Windows package manager detection for UWP app execution aliases (e.g. winget)
- Fixed subagent conclusion file writes failing in read-only working directories
- Fixed manual override Promise never resolving when user sends messages directly on subagent page
- Fixed subagent retry and continue operations failing due to parentToolUseId filtering
- Fixed stale streaming content duplicating after WebSocket reconnection
- Fixed summaryModel being cleared when provider credentials are not yet loaded

## Performance

- RecentTabs: RAF-batched WS updates reduce unnecessary React re-renders
- WebSocket manager: microtask-batched dispatch for non-latency-sensitive messages
- Background task event waiting now uses typed event subscriptions instead of catch-all listener
- Ruler infinite scroll capped at 20 pages to prevent memory exhaustion

## Refactoring

- Split narrator-subagent.ts (2281 lines) into 7 focused modules with barrel re-exports
- Image upload limit separated from text file limit (20MB vs 100MB)
- Background task output buffer capped at 12MB as defensive memory guard
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 统一后台任务管理：bash 和 agent 后台任务持久化到数据库，服务重启后不再丢失
- 新增 `AwaitBackgroundTask` 工具，支持文本匹配和超时等待后台任务
- 内置网关全局 HTTPS 代理支持，新增专属设置页面
- 子代理标签页独立显示，使用机器人图标，支持返回父叙述者
- SWE-bench 评估器支持 Podman 容器隔离运行，自动配置仓库环境
- ExitPlanMode 权限在有反馈文本时显示确认对话框

## 修复

- 修复第三方 Anthropic 兼容 API（如 DeepSeek）返回 thinking block 导致的 400 错误
- 修复多处前端内存泄漏：截图 blob URL、头像 fetch 竞态、PixiJS 销毁崩溃、点击拦截器定时器、终端 disposable
- 修复 start:dev 模式下 WebSocket 端口注入失败
- 修复 Windows 下 winget 等 UWP 应用别名检测失败
- 修复只读工作目录下子代理结论文件写入失败
- 修复用户在子代理页面直接发送消息时手动覆盖 Promise 永远不解析
- 修复子代理重试和继续操作因 parentToolUseId 过滤而失败
- 修复 WebSocket 重连后流式内容重复显示
- 修复 summaryModel 在提供商凭据未加载时被意外清空

## 性能优化

- RecentTabs 使用 RAF 批量更新，减少不必要的 React 重渲染
- WebSocket 管理器对非延迟敏感消息使用 microtask 批量分发
- 后台任务等待改用按类型订阅事件，避免全局事件监听开销
- Ruler 无限滚动限制为 20 页，防止内存溢出

## 重构

- 将 narrator-subagent.ts（2281 行）拆分为 7 个职责清晰的模块
- 图片上传限制与文本文件限制分离（20MB vs 100MB）
- 后台任务输出缓冲区增加 12MB 防御性内存上限
